convert_timeout_to_deadline: convert a relative timeout in seconds to an absolute Unix timestamp deadline
handle_none_timeout: handle a None timeout value by returning None instead of computing a deadline
compute_absolute_deadline: compute an absolute deadline by adding the current time to a relative timeout value
review_timeout_conversion: review the _timeout_to_deadline function to understand how it converts relative timeouts to absolute deadlines
test_timeout_edge_cases: test the _timeout_to_deadline function with None, zero, and positive float timeout values
